title: Only Cats
rules: Every post must link directly to an image (jpg, png, webp or gif) of a cat hosted on forgeimg.net or i.imgur.com. Big cats count.
Real cats only: no drawings, cartoons, AI art, sculptures or plush toys. Captioned cat photos are fine.
New posts are checked by a bot within a minute; rejected posts are deleted after a day.

challenges.name: publication-match
challenges.description: New posts wait for the cat check before they appear.
